title: Exponential growth and decay estimates for eigenfunctions with complex eigenvalues
summary: We prove a priori exponential growth and decay estimates for locally square integrable eigenfunctions with complex eigenvalues of the non-self-adjoint Schrödinger operator. There appear two natural critical exponents, given by the imaginary parts of square roots of twice an eigenvalue. Any associated eigenfunction has the same exponential growth or decay rate as one of these, or greater than the upper one.
